description: Publish now, schedule, or (default when the user did not ask to publish right now) leave a DRAFT of a post on a project's connected accounts. Ask the user before publishing or scheduling: it posts to real accounts. Verify content first: never fake news, copyrighted media or spam. Never use another page's text as the copy or its branded picture as the post's picture: the picture comes from the organization's templates (viralhunt_get_template), either rendered by you and passed in media, or passed as `design` with draft=true so the app renders it when a person approves. Returns {id, status, results, warnings, review_url}: status processing|scheduled|draft|partial|failed; results keyed by account id carry each network's own reason when it refused.

body.description: Caption/text. Optional if media or design is provided.

card_id.description: The Editorial Board card this post comes from (optional).

design.description: The picture as a filled template instead of a rendered file: {"template": "<slug or id>", "format": "feed", "variables": {"text": "…", "highlight": "…", "image": "https://…", "caption": "…"}}. Needs draft=true when media is empty; the app renders it when a person approves.

draft.description: true = save it in Drafts for a person to review and approve; nothing is sent. Use it unless the user explicitly asked to publish now.

media.description: Public image/video URLs. Check media_limits (viralhunt_targets) before a big video.

networks.description: Post to every account on these networks, e.g. ["instagram","facebook"].

overrides.description: Per-network (or per account id) copy or media: {"bluesky": {"body": "short version"}, "12": {"media": ["…"]}}. Bluesky takes 300 characters, X 280.

project.description: Project name — REQUIRED if the org has more than one project.

project_id.description: Project id — alternative to project name.

scheduled_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC, e.g. 2026-08-01T15:30:00Z. Omit = publish now (or, with draft, the tentative time is 'when approved').

target_account_ids.description: Exact account ids (from viralhunt_targets). Omit = all accounts in the project.

name: viralhunt_schedule
